$description: Obsidian semantic overrides. Obsidian is a fixed dark-mode identity: the base section carries the type scale, the Playfair/Inter families, the crisp shape scale and the two source motion durations; the dark section carries the warm near-black surface stack, the 24K gold accent set, the muted status roles and near-black elevation with a restrained gold glow.

sans.$value: "Inter Variable", "Inter", system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif
sans.$description: Body copy and UI: Inter, with the Chinese system sans faces immediately after it so CJK text never falls through to a Latin serif.

heading.$value: "Playfair Display Variable", "Playfair Display", 'Times New Roman', 'Songti SC', Georgia, serif
heading.$description: Latin display headings and key figures: Playfair Display. Chinese headings fall back to Songti SC / the system serif, matching the source type pairing.

mono.$value: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
mono.$description: Code, identifiers and tabular annotations: the source system's mono stack.

display.$description: Hero title: the source text-display-2xl step.

h1.$description: Section title: the source text-display-xl step.

h2.$description: Sub-section title: the source text-display-lg step.

h3.$description: Card-group title: the source text-heading-lg step.

h4.$description: Card title: the source text-heading-md step.

body-lg.$description: Lead paragraph and the source text-heading-sm step at the same size.

small.$description: Supporting copy and button labels: the source text-body-sm step.

caption.$description: Footnotes and copyright; the source overline is this size with wide tracking.

code.$description: Code blocks use the source text-caption step.

control.$description: Control labels: the source button size at sm/md.

label.$description: Uppercase eyebrow and overline tracking from the source design system.

small.$description: Source radius-sm: small elements inside controls.

modal.$description: Source radius-2xl: dialogs, the hero panel and the CTA block.

fast.$description: Source duration-fast: hover and color transitions.

normal.$description: Source duration-base: buttons, inputs and focus transitions.

bg-subtle.$description: Interactive / inset surface: source surface-interactive (hover and selected fills, wells). The core contract's only tertiary surface role.

surface-elevated.$description: Overlays, inputs and popovers: source surface-elevated.

fg-muted.$description: Secondary text: source content-secondary; content-tertiary has no core semantic slot.

fg-strong.$description: Headings and high-emphasis text: one warm step above primary content.

accent.$description: 24K gold: source accent-solid, primary actions, links, selection and focus.

accent-hover.$description: Source accent-hover and content-accent: emphasis text and hover.

on-accent.$description: Ink text on a solid gold fill: source accent-contrast.

accent-subtle.$description: Source accent-soft: gold chip and selected background at 10%.

focus-ring.$description: Source focus ring colour (gold-300), made opaque so the ring is visible on every surface.

danger.$description: Danger text and icons: source status-danger, AA on the canvas.

danger-solid.$description: Destructive button fill: derived claret, paired with warm ivory text.

info-solid.$description: Solid informational fill: derived steel, paired with warm ivory text.

sm.$description: Inputs and micro popovers: source shadow-xs.

xl.$description: Hero panels and dialogs: source shadow-lg.

glow.$description: Primary gold button and CTA: source shadow-glow, reserved for the one gold focal point.
